summary: Alkami Technology filed an 8-K to disclose a $100 million share repurchase program authorized by its Board on April 23, 2026. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans at management's discretion based on market conditions and liquidity. No specific price, premium, or expiration date was provided. The program is not an obligation and can be modified or terminated at any time. This capital return initiative signals management's view of undervaluation and commitment to shareholder returns. Watch for future announcements of actual repurchase execution and any impact on EPS.
